data.name: Action_ClearCellOutput
data.comment: Name of the built-in extension that clears one cell's output, as listed in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Action_ClearCellOutput_Description
data.value: Clears the output of the selected cell.
data.comment: Second line of the Clear Output entry in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Action_ClearCellOutput_Label
data.comment: Cell toolbar button. Shorter than the extension's name because it sits on a cell, where the word 'cell' is already implied.

data.name: Action_ClearOutputs
data.comment: Toolbar button, and the name of the same built-in extension in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Action_ClearOutputs_Description
data.value: Clears all cell outputs in the notebook.
data.comment: Second line of the Clear Outputs entry in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Action_ExportHtml
data.comment: Name of the built-in HTML export, as listed in the Extensions panel. Its menu entry reads only 'HTML' and is not translated.

data.name: Action_ExportHtml_Description
data.value: Exports the notebook as a self-contained HTML document.
data.comment: Second line of the Export HTML entry in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Action_ExportMarkdown
data.comment: Name of the built-in Markdown export, as listed in the Extensions panel. Its menu entry reads only 'Markdown' and is not translated.

data.name: Action_ExportMarkdown_Description
data.value: Exports the notebook as a Markdown document.
data.comment: Second line of the Export Markdown entry in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Action_ExportVerso
data.comment: Name of the built-in .verso export, as listed in the Extensions panel. Verso is a product name.

data.name: Action_ExportVerso_Description
data.value: Exports a Markdown-backed notebook as a native .verso file.
data.comment: Second line of the Export Verso entry in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Action_RestartKernel
data.comment: Toolbar button, and the name of the same built-in extension in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Action_RestartKernel_Confirm
data.value: Restarting the kernel discards all variables and execution state. Restart now?
data.comment: Confirmation dialog shown before the kernel restarts, because the effect cannot be undone.

data.name: Action_RestartKernel_Description
data.comment: Second line of the Restart Kernel entry in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Action_RunAll
data.comment: The toolbar's primary button, and the name of the same built-in extension in the Extensions panel. Keep it short: it sits next to the kernel status.

data.name: Action_RunAll_Description
data.value: Executes all cells in the notebook.
data.comment: Second line of the Run All entry in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Action_RunCell
data.comment: Cell toolbar button, and the name of the same built-in extension in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Action_RunCell_Description
data.comment: Second line of the Run Cell entry in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Action_SwitchLayout
data.comment: Toolbar button, and the name of the same built-in extension in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Action_SwitchLayout_Description
data.comment: Second line of the Switch Layout entry in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Action_SwitchTheme
data.comment: Toolbar button, and the name of the same built-in extension in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Action_SwitchTheme_Description
data.comment: Second line of the Switch Theme entry in the Extensions panel.

data.name: CellType_Code
data.comment: The kind of cell that holds code. Offered wherever a new cell can be added.

data.name: CellType_Html
data.comment: Name of the built-in HTML cell type, as listed in the Extensions panel. Its entry in the new-cell list reads only 'HTML' and is not translated.

data.name: CellType_Html_Description
data.value: HTML cell type for authoring raw HTML with @variable substitution.
data.comment: Second line of the HTML cell type entry in the Extensions panel. '@variable' is typed by the reader and stays as written.

data.name: CellType_Markdown
data.comment: Name of the built-in Markdown cell type, as listed in the Extensions panel.

data.name: CellType_Markdown_Description
data.value: Markdown prose cells rendered to HTML with Markdig.
data.comment: Second line of the Markdown cell type entry in the Extensions panel. Markdig is a library name.

data.name: CellType_Mermaid
data.comment: Name of the built-in Mermaid cell type, as listed in the Extensions panel.

data.name: CellType_Mermaid_Description
data.value: Mermaid cell type for creating diagrams with mermaid.js syntax.
data.comment: Second line of the Mermaid cell type entry in the Extensions panel. mermaid.js is a library name.

data.name: CellType_Parameters
data.comment: Name of the built-in parameters cell type, as listed in the Extensions panel.

data.name: CellType_Parameters_Description
data.value: Displays and manages notebook parameter definitions as an interactive form.
data.comment: Second line of the parameters cell type entry in the Extensions panel.

data.name: CellType_Parameters_Label
data.comment: The parameters cell as offered in the new-cell list.

data.name: Kernel_Html
data.comment: Name of the built-in HTML kernel, as listed in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Kernel_Html_Description
data.comment: Second line of the HTML kernel entry in the Extensions panel. '@variable' is typed by the reader and stays as written.

data.name: Kernel_Mermaid
data.comment: Name of the built-in Mermaid kernel, as listed in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Kernel_Mermaid_Description
data.value: Executes Mermaid diagram cells with @variable substitution.
data.comment: Second line of the Mermaid kernel entry in the Extensions panel. '@variable' is typed by the reader and stays as written.

data.name: Layout_AddCell
data.comment: Button under the last cell that appends a new one. {0} is the kind of cell, such as Code or Markdown.

data.name: Layout_Dashboard
data.comment: Name of the built-in dashboard layout, as listed in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Layout_Dashboard_Description
data.value: Grid-based dashboard layout showing output-only cells.
data.comment: Second line of the dashboard layout entry in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Layout_Dashboard_Label
data.comment: The dashboard layout as offered in the layout picker.

data.name: Layout_DragToMove
data.comment: Tooltip on the handle that repositions a cell on the dashboard.

data.name: Layout_EmptySubtitle
data.comment: Second line of the empty-notebook message, pointing at the row of buttons under it.

data.name: Layout_EmptyTitle
data.comment: Shown in place of the cells when a notebook has none yet.

data.name: Layout_InsertCellHere
data.comment: Tooltip on a button that adds a cell between two others. {0} is the kind of cell, such as Code or Markdown.

data.name: Layout_Notebook
data.comment: Name of the built-in notebook layout, as listed in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Layout_Notebook_Description
data.value: Linear top-to-bottom notebook layout with live, editable cells in elevated cards.
data.comment: Second line of the notebook layout entry in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Layout_Notebook_Label
data.comment: The notebook layout as offered in the layout picker.

data.name: Layout_Presentation
data.comment: Name of the built-in presentation layout, as listed in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Layout_Presentation_Description
data.value: Output-only presentation layout for consuming interactive notebooks.
data.comment: Second line of the presentation layout entry in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Layout_Presentation_Label
data.comment: The presentation layout as offered in the layout picker.

data.name: Layout_RunCell
data.comment: Tooltip on the button that runs one cell on the dashboard. Keep it to a word: the button holds only an icon.

data.name: Parameters_Add
data.comment: Button that opens the row for entering a new parameter.

data.name: Parameters_Applied
data.comment: Shown after the values in a parameters cell have been handed to the kernel.

data.name: Parameters_CancelAdd
data.comment: Tooltip on the cross that abandons the new parameter.

data.name: Parameters_ColumnDefault
data.comment: Column heading in the parameters table.

data.name: Parameters_ColumnDescription
data.comment: Column heading in the parameters table.

data.name: Parameters_ColumnName
data.comment: Column heading in the parameters table.

data.name: Parameters_ColumnRequired
data.comment: Column heading in the parameters table.

data.name: Parameters_ColumnType
data.comment: Column heading in the parameters table.

data.name: Parameters_ConfirmAdd
data.comment: Tooltip on the tick that saves the new parameter.

data.name: Parameters_DefaultPlaceholder
data.comment: Grey prompt inside the empty default-value box. Lower case, matching the other prompts in the row.

data.name: Parameters_DescriptionPlaceholder
data.comment: Grey prompt inside the empty description box. Lower case, matching the other prompts in the row.

data.name: Parameters_InvalidValue
data.comment: Shown beside a parameter whose value does not fit its type.

data.name: Parameters_NamePlaceholder
data.comment: Grey prompt inside the empty name box. Lower case, matching the other prompts in the row.

data.name: Parameters_None
data.comment: Shown in a parameters cell that has nothing in it yet.

data.name: Parameters_NotFound
data.comment: Shown when a parameter has been removed under the reader's feet. {0} is the parameter's name.

data.name: Parameters_Remove
data.comment: Tooltip on the cross that deletes a parameter.

data.name: Parameters_Required
data.comment: Checkbox beside a new parameter, marking it as one the notebook cannot run without. Lower case, matching the prompts in the same row.

data.name: Parameters_Title
data.comment: Heading of the parameters cell.

data.name: Properties_CollapseInput
data.comment: Switch that hides a cell's source and leaves its output showing.

data.name: Properties_DefaultIs
data.comment: Note under a cell visibility setting saying what it falls back to. {0} is one of the visibility states.

data.name: Properties_DisplaySection
data.comment: Heading over the settings that control how a cell is drawn.

data.name: Properties_InputPreviewLines
data.comment: How many lines of source a collapsed cell shows.

data.name: Properties_Output
data.comment: Label on the control choosing how much of a cell's output is shown.

data.name: Properties_OutputFull
data.comment: Output setting: show all of it.

data.name: Properties_OutputHidden
data.comment: Output setting: show none of it.

data.name: Properties_OutputPreview
data.comment: Output setting: show the first few lines.

data.name: Properties_OutputPreviewLines
data.comment: How many lines of output a previewed cell shows.

data.name: Properties_PreviewStyle
data.comment: Label on the control choosing how a preview is drawn.

data.name: Properties_PreviewStyleLines
data.comment: Preview style: the first few lines, as written.

data.name: Properties_VisibilitySection
data.comment: Heading over the settings that control which layouts a cell appears in.

data.name: PropertyProvider_Display
data.comment: Name of the built-in provider of the Display settings, as listed in the Extensions panel.

data.name: Renderer_Mermaid_Description

data.name: Theme_Light
data.comment: The built-in light theme. Verso is a product name and stays as written; the word describing the theme is translated.

data.name: Theme_Light_Description
data.value: Default light theme for Verso notebooks.

data.name: Visibility_Collapsed
data.comment: Cell visibility state: the cell is drawn folded shut.

data.name: Visibility_Hidden
data.comment: Cell visibility state: the cell is not drawn at all.

data.comment: Cell visibility state: the output is drawn and the source is not.

data.name: Visibility_Visible
data.comment: Cell visibility state: the whole cell is drawn.
